text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth needs the explosive power to decide a race right at the wire.
To that end, I assigned her a rather grueling regimen for this training camp.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*, *gasp*... —Phew. Does that conclude today's training?
choice_data_list: Great work! Let's keep up this momentum!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì, certo! You told me that completing this menu would lead to my growth, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall face every single étude with all my heart.
For I believe in your baton!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it seems you've brought a challenge of your own
to this training camp as well.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I must do my best so as not to be outdone by your passionate fiamma.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a brief moment of free time before lights out,
I came down to the beach alone, violin in hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To understand Sounds of Earth more deeply, I took up
the very first instrument she ever touched, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*screeech*... *skreeeech*...)
choice_data_list: I'm not getting any better at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was another reason I kept practicing the violin.
I wanted to express my appreciation for her enduring this hard training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not with words, but with music.
I knew that would bring her the greatest joy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*screeech*... *skreeeech*...)
choice_data_list: I have to get better before the last day...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Our impetuoso training camp comes to an end today, does it... Oh, a message?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
From Trainer, is it?
An "invitation," hmm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I took deep breaths to calm my nerves,
Sounds of Earth approached me.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Greetings, amore! I thought all our scheduled training finished this afternoon, but—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see. So the "invitation" I received
was from you and that violin, was it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I nodded and raised the violin into position.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't produce exquisite tones like she did.
Even so—I could at least express my feelings.
choice_data_list: I want to reward all your hard work with everything I've got!
I want to reward all your hard work with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The regimen I gave Sounds of Earth at this camp
would have made ordinary horsegirls throw in the towel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet she followed through to the very end without a single complaint.
Placing her absolute trust in me all the while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might take a little more time, but I swear I'll become a conductor worthy of her.
And someday—
choice_data_list: (I'll send you to the greatest stage of all!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might take a little more time, but I swear I'll become a conductor worthy of her.
And someday—
choice_data_list: (I'll send you to the greatest stage of all!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: Th-Thank you very much for listening.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Bene. ...Molto bene...! What a truly passionate performance...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: How dazzling each and every note played was! It has been etched deep and clear into my heart! Benissimo!!
choice_data_list: Phew... I'm honored you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Thank you for such a magnificent concerto! I relished your beautiful musica from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: One must not merely pursue technical perfection. The most vital element of a performance is passionate emozione!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: My amico is truly a wonderful esecutore!
choice_data_list: I know it was pretty clumsy, but... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: My amica is truly a wonderful esecutore!
choice_data_list: I know it was pretty clumsy, but... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No player is skillful from the very start.
Even I was no different from you at first.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yet that doesn't matter in the least.
My mother and everyone in the orchestra taught me as much.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: It happened in my childhood, the very first time I played the violin in public. It was my way of thanking them for always treating me to their bellissima music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Technically, it was quite unrefined. Yet I desperately poured myself into every single note.
For that was all I could do back then.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And then, I felt my fingers gradually grow lighter.
Yes... my heart transformed into sound and reached my mother and the others.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
When the piece ended, a shower of applause greeted me.
I shall never forget that sight as long as I live.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And so, once more, to you—a truly splendid esecutore— allow me to offer my unsparing praise!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Braviiiiiissimo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my!? Fireworks?! Is this a surprise as well?
You truly are a romantic director, aren't you!
choice_data_list: No way! That was pure coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fantastico! In that case, these fireworks are summer's very own applause for your musica!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: By the way, amore. Must this concerto reach its finale after only one piece?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, would you humor a request from your sole spettatore?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to take the stage as well. I wish to play musica together, in harmony with the sound of the fireworks!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Grazie mille! Let us revel in this session!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I played a piece I could hardly claim to have mastered.
To avoid making mistakes on difficult sections, I naturally slowed down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The duet of our violins, joined by the melody of fireworks as an arrangement,
made the piece sound infinitely better than my solo ever did!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Earth seemed to be enjoying herself even more than usual.
—Somehow, that was what her melody seemed to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There is still so much I don't know about Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I realized I could bring a smile to her face through music.
It was a massive step forward, one too joyful for mere words to convey.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Molto bene.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth's lips seemed to move ever so slightly—
but her voice was drowned out by the fireworks and our playing.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for staging such a delightful concerto.
You made this a truly magnificent evening.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When we come to understand each other even more... along with the music we play,
I want to perform a violin duet with you again—that is what I told her.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...! Sì, certo! Ah, I can hardly wait!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That performance will surely be—
the most beautiful session on this entire planet!
